description: Triage report for incoming TiDB slow query execution plans

classifications.description: Map of plan_id (string key) to classified root cause. Use 'healthy' for plans matching no known anomaly pattern. Root cause labels must match verified_root_cause values in the incidents database.

top_remediations.description: Map of plan_id (string key) to a ranked list of remediation strategies, ordered by average historical effectiveness (highest first). Only include entries for plans classified as anomalous (not 'healthy').

strategy.description: Name of the remediation strategy (must match strategy values in remediations table)

avg_effectiveness.description: Average actual_improvement_pct across all historical applications of this strategy for the matched root cause

correlated_plans.description: Sorted list of plan_id values for plans that appear to be related symptoms of a single underlying issue (e.g., same table/index accessed under different conditions producing divergent performance)

shared_root_cause.description: The root cause shared by the correlated plans
